Qui Lounge — Night Out Review 🌟🌟
Aug 2026 • Friends
Qui Lounge — Night Out Review

Table service was genuinely a highlight — attentive throughout the night, quick to refill, and on top of everything without being intrusive. Security was also solid — felt well looked after throughout the night. The vibe at the start was great — good energy, nice crowd, striking decor with a bold hand-painted floral mural as a backdrop.

Unfortunately, the energy died down noticeably after the second DJ came on.

The bottle service issue — my main complaint: Our total bill came to just over 21,000,000 VND, closer to 24,000,000 VND with tips — and a large portion of that was a bottle of Clase Azul at 17,000,000 VND that was clearly not authentic. It was bitter, overly boozy, with a harsh alcohol smell — none of the smooth sweetness Clase Azul is actually known for. At this price point, that’s not a taste preference issue, it’s a trust issue.

To be clear, this isn’t a knock on the staff — the servers and security were hardworking and attentive all night, and they deserve to be recognized for that. The accountability here falls on whoever sources and purchases the liquor inventory for the lounge. If you’re going to charge premium bottle service prices for named, labeled products, the venue has a responsibility to guarantee what’s being poured is authentic.

The manager’s response — proactively offering champagne and a free round of B52s before we even said anything — read as an acknowledgment that something was off, rather than a real fix. Free drinks don’t resolve the core issue of being sold what appears to be a counterfeit bottle at premium pricing.

Bottom line: Excellent table and security service — genuinely hardworking staff who deserve credit. But spending over 21 million VND on a night that included an inauthentic bottle is a serious problem that falls squarely on procurement, not the team on the floor. It’s made me question whether bottle service here can be trusted going forward.

Lovely ambience and great service
Mar 2023
Visited Qui Cuisine Mixology during my recent trip to Ho Chi Minh at a recommendation of an acquaintance. 

We had a lovely dinner of the salmon, lamb chops, bone marrow and sides. The done-ness of the salmon and lamb chops were perfect. We also enjoyed the ambience of the place. 

Would like to compliment Nancy who went the extra mile to assist in checking on my dining record as I had lost my receipt and wanted to note down the items we ordered for memory's sake. She was really friendly and helpful in her responses & all these help rendered was days after I had returned to my home country! Appreciated that she went that extra mile to help me.
